title: Scientists Unearth a Massive 40-Foot ‘Hell Heron’ Dinosaur That Hunted Sahara Shallows Hundreds of Miles From Any Ancient Sea
description: A bizarre new dinosaur from the Sahara is forcing scientists to rethink Spinosaurus, and its terrifying way of hunting.

title: In 50,000 years, one ancient love story left an uneven genetic signature: Scientists say Neanderthal fathers may have contributed far more surviving descendants than Neanderthal mothers
description: Recent studies reveal that modern humans possess Neanderthal DNA due to interbreeding long ago. Interestingly, evidence shows that lineages thriving today often came from Neanderthal fathers and human mothers, highlighting a significant gender imbalance in these ancient unions. Particularly, the X chromosome provides essential insights into how this genetic blend occurred, indicating more about survival than any prehistoric romance.

title: Archaeology Department asks WRD to restore, not demolish, Kalingarayan aqueduct
description: Archaeology Department urges WRD to restore the historic Kalingarayan aqueduct instead of demolishing it, ensuring preservation.

title: These designers are reviving an ancient craft — using plastic waste
description: Cairo-based Reform Studio turns used plastic bags into a fabric to make furniture, clothes and handbags.

title: Quote of the day by Chanakya: "Before you start some work, always ask yourself three questions..." — Timeless life lessons on wise decisions, strategic thinking, purposeful action, and why this ancient wisdom from history's greatest strategist still runs modern minds
description: Today's Quote of the Day by Chanakya asks three simple questions that could change the way you make decisions forever. Long before modern psychology and business strategy, history's greatest political thinker revealed a timeless formula for success. Discover why this ancient wisdom still shapes leaders, entrepreneurs, and everyday life across the world.
